yb1396.name: Iran Statistical Yearbook 1396, Table 15.2 Crimes occurred in the jurisdiction of the police by type of offence
yb1396.publisher: Statistical Centre of Iran (Iran Statistical Yearbook); data source stated in table: Police Department (NAJA) of the Islamic Republic of Iran
yb1396.notes: Figures obtained with the WebFetch tool (text extraction); the shell could not reach amar.org.ir. New table series from the 1395 yearbook on, counting persons murdered ("Murder (person)") in crimes occurring in police jurisdiction; national figures differ from the older lawsuit series (e.g. 1394: 1920 here vs 2754 lawsuits). Province values sum exactly to the national total. Only the murder column is used (the extracted headers of other columns were scrambled). Tehran is split into police commands Grand Tehran, Eastern Tehran and Western Tehran, and Kish island is listed separately; these have no matching boundary and are left without a shape.

problems: amar.org.ir, lmo.ir and forensic.ir unreachable from the shell; lmo.ir refuses WebFetch (robots). Most figures therefore come from WebFetch text extraction of Statistical Centre of Iran yearbook chapters, checked by summing provinces to the published national totals (all match). The 1395 yearbook chapter (15.pdf) text layer is font-garbled, so 1395 province figures were not used; 1398 and 1400+ yearbook chapter URLs were refused by WebFetch (not reachable from search results) and are missing. Legal Medicine Organization homicide deaths by province not obtained.
